title: Path of Least Resistance
description: Paths give speed with mod support.
body:
Do you want to walk or run faster on paths in minecraft? Try Path of Least Resistance!

Supported MC version 1.16.2 - 26.1.2

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/0GLVqGpa2gI" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Optional mod support for these mods:

- [Macaw's Paths and Pavings](https://modrinth.com/mod/macaws-paths-and-pavings)
- MorePaths
- [Decorative paths](https://modrinth.com/mod/decorative-paths)
- More Paths Repathed
- [Automatic Paths](https://modrinth.com/mod/autopath/versions)

config:

global speed /scoreboard players set polr.settings speed <1-5>

player speed /scoreboard players set <playername> speed <1-5>

global particle /scoreboard players set polr.settings particle <0-1> 0 = particles off 1= particles on
